docs.title: Introduction
Installation
docs.text:
LLVM 16 is supported. To compile from source you need both the LLVM and Clang development packages installed:

sudo apt install llvm-16 llvm-16-dev libclang-16-dev clang-16
make && make install   # build and install the source code transformation tool

Optionally you can remove the development libraries and keep only the runtime:

sudo apt purge llvm-16 libllvm-16-dev libclang-16-dev clang-16  # remove development libraries
sudo apt install libllvm16 libclang-common-16-dev               # install runtime dependencies

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
h5cpp your_translation_unit.cpp -- -v $(CXXFLAGS) -Dgenerated.h

This runs the compiler front end on the specified input and outputs the necessary HDF5 type descriptors (or an error message if any).
